description: Set a brand's DESCRIPTION in ONE language, leaving every other language as it is; null or an empty description removes that language. Translate the text yourself — Obriym does not translate for MCP clients. Never translate a brand NAME: marketplaces match it verbatim. Call list_content_locales first; the workspace's base language is refused (use update_brand for it). update_brand's translations field REPLACES the whole set, so use this tool to change a single language. Idempotent. Returns a warning when the CRM does not show that language yet. Echoes the workspace.

brandId.description: The brand id returned by list_brands.

description.description: The brand description in this language. null or an empty string clears that language. The brand NAME is never translated.

locale.description: The language to write, as an ISO 639-1 code. Call list_content_locales for the codes this workspace uses; never the workspace's base language.

name: upsert_brand_translation
title: Set a brand translation
